assertion.value: This study was conducted in accordance with GDPR guidelines. Before the user test, participants were informed about the consent form, which complies with GDPR requirements, and were asked to read it in advance. At the beginning of the evaluation, we reviewed the form with them again and emphasized key points, including that the interviews would be recorded, how the data would be used and stored, the retention period, and that all data would remain internal and confidential. Participants were also informed that they could request deletion of their data at any time. All participants signed the consent forms before the evaluation sessions were recorded. No sensitive personal data were collected; the focus was solely on their experience of using our prototype.
